name: coui-figma-token-sync
description: Figma plugin that imports CoUI design tokens (build/tokens.figma.json) into Figma Variables.

scripts.build: node scripts/bundle-owner.mjs check && HASH=$(find src code.ts -name '*.ts' -not -path 'src/data/*' | sort | xargs cat | shasum -a 256 | cut -c1-16) && ENTRY_HASHES=$(node scripts/entry-source-hash.mjs) && REF="$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)@$(git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)" && esbuild code.ts --bundle --target=es2017 --define:__SHARED_SOURCE_HASH__="\"$HASH\"" --define:__ENTRY_SOURCE_HASHES__="$ENTRY_HASHES" --define:__BUILD_REF__="\"$REF\"" --outfile=code.js 2>&1 && node scripts/bundle-owner.mjs stamp
scripts.watch: node scripts/bundle-owner.mjs check && HASH=$(find src code.ts -name '*.ts' -not -path 'src/data/*' | sort | xargs cat | shasum -a 256 | cut -c1-16) && ENTRY_HASHES=$(node scripts/entry-source-hash.mjs) && REF="$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)@$(git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)" && esbuild code.ts --bundle --target=es2017 --define:__SHARED_SOURCE_HASH__="\"$HASH\"" --define:__ENTRY_SOURCE_HASHES__="$ENTRY_HASHES" --define:__BUILD_REF__="\"$REF\"" --outfile=code.js --watch 2>&1
